Class CodeRefiner

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.agi.tool.ToolContext
uno.anahata.asi.agi.tool.AnahataToolkit
uno.anahata.asi.intellij.tools.java.CodeRefiner
All Implemented Interfaces:
ContextProvider, PropertyChangeSource, Rebindable
public class CodeRefiner extends AnahataToolkit
AST-based, non-textual maintenance operations on Java source files: structural import management, IDE-rule reformatting, and annotation insertion.

This is the IntelliJ port of the NetBeans V3 CodeRefiner. Where NetBeans drives WorkingCopy/TreeMaker, IntelliJ mutates the live PSI tree inside a WriteCommandAction. Because AI tool calls arrive on background threads, every mutation is marshalled onto the EDT via ApplicationManager.getApplication().invokeAndWait; PSI reads needed to resolve targets run inside that same command.

Author:
anahata

      public String addImports(String filePath, List<String> imports, boolean save) throws AgiToolException
      Adds one or more imports to a Java file structurally (as real import statements, resolving each fully-qualified name against the project).
      Parameters:
      filePath - the absolute path of the Java file.
      imports - the fully-qualified type names to import.
      save - whether to persist the file to disk afterwards.
      Returns:
      a summary of which imports were added or skipped.
      Throws:
      AgiToolException - if the file is not a resolvable Java source file.

    • optimizeImports

      public String optimizeImports(String filePath, boolean removeUnused, boolean save) throws AgiToolException
      Optimizes the imports of a Java file: removes unused imports (when requested) and shortens any fully-qualified references to simple names, adding imports as needed. Delegates to IntelliJ's JavaCodeStyleManager.
      Parameters:
      filePath - the absolute path of the Java file.
      removeUnused - whether unused imports should be removed.
      save - whether to persist the file to disk afterwards.
      Returns:
      a confirmation message.
      Throws:
      AgiToolException - if the file is not a resolvable Java source file.

    • addAnnotation

      public String addAnnotation(String filePath, String memberFqn, String annotation, boolean save) throws AgiToolException
      Adds an annotation to a class, method, or field identified by its canonical fully-qualified name.

      The annotation text may include arguments (e.g. SuppressWarnings("unchecked")) and an optional leading @. References inside the annotation are shortened to simple names where an import is available.

      Parameters:
      filePath - the absolute path of the Java file.
      memberFqn - the canonical FQN of the target class/method/field.
      annotation - the annotation source (with or without a leading @).
      save - whether to persist the file to disk afterwards.
      Returns:
      a confirmation message.
      Throws:
      AgiToolException - if the file or target member cannot be resolved.

    • runWrite

      private void runWrite(com.intellij.openapi.project.Project project, CodeRefiner.WriteBody action) throws AgiToolException
      Runs a mutating PSI operation as a single undoable write command on the EDT.

      Marshals onto the EDT (AI tool calls arrive on background threads) and wraps the body in a WriteCommandAction. Checked AgiToolExceptions thrown by the body are unwrapped and rethrown so the model receives a clean error.

      Parameters:
      project - the project owning the document.
      action - the mutation to perform.
      Throws:
      AgiToolException - if the mutation reports a domain error.
